title: Screen pattern
instruction: Check colour blocks and text.
criterion: Colours are distinct and the image is steady, without lines, corrupted blocks or flickering.
expected: No flicker, lines or corrupted pixels.

title: Internal touchscreen
instruction: Sweep the screen, edges and corners.
criterion: Yellow marks follow your finger across the screen. No new marks appear when you lift it.
expected: Yellow dots mark contacts; gaps show untested areas.

title: Brightness
instruction: Run cycles the backlight through three levels.
criterion: Brightness changes and returns to its starting level.
expected: Returns to the starting brightness.

title: Display off and on
instruction: Run blanks the display for 2 s, then restores it.
criterion: The picture returns without persistent corruption or flicker.
expected: Picture returns without corruption or flicker.

title: Brief vibration
instruction: Hold the phone. Run triggers a short vibration.
criterion: You feel a brief pulse that stops immediately afterwards.
expected: One brief pulse.

title: First torch LED
instruction: Point the rear LEDs away from your eyes. Run pulses LED 1.
criterion: One rear LED lights briefly and turns fully off.
expected: LED lights, then turns fully off.

title: Second torch LED
instruction: Point the rear LEDs away from your eyes. Run pulses LED 2.
criterion: The other rear LED lights briefly and turns fully off.
expected: LED lights, then turns fully off.

title: Earpiece speaker
instruction: Run plays the left channel through the earpiece.
criterion: The earpiece speaker is audible, without rattling or distortion.
expected: Clear tone, no rattling or distortion.

title: Bottom speaker
instruction: Run plays the right channel through the bottom speaker.
criterion: The bottom speaker is audible, without rattling or distortion.
expected: Clear tone, no rattling or distortion.

title: Microphone playback
instruction: Run records 3 s of speech, then plays it back.
criterion: Your speech is recognisable without severe noise or distortion.
expected: Clear speech. Recording is deleted after playback.

title: IMU: bubble level
instruction: Tilt the phone in each direction.
criterion: The bubble follows tilt toward the raised edge, centers when level, and stays steady when the phone is still.
expected: Bubble follows the raised edge and centers when level.

title: Magnetic compass
instruction: Keep flat; compare with a magnetic-north reference.
criterion: The compass turns smoothly and agrees with the reference device when both use magnetic north.
expected: Heading agrees in several directions.

title: Face-up and face-down tilt
instruction: Turn screen-up, upright, then screen-down.
criterion: The labels change to face-up, vertical and face-down respectively. Choose Fail if face-up and face-down are reversed.
expected: Expect face-up, vertical, then face-down.

title: Ambient light sensor
instruction: Cover and uncover the sensor at the top.
criterion: The displayed light reading changes clearly between covered and uncovered.
expected: Light reading changes.

title: Proximity sensor
instruction: Move your hand toward and away from the top.
criterion: The displayed proximity state changes near and far.
expected: State switches between near and far.

title: External display modes
instruction: Select resolution and Hz, then Apply.
criterion: The external pattern is stable at the selected resolution and refresh rate, with correct geometry and visible borders.
expected: Stable pattern, correct aspect ratio, visible borders.

title: Reverse the USB-C plug
instruction: Unplug, wait 5 s, flip the USB-C plug and reconnect.
criterion: The monitor picture returns in the other orientation.
expected: Picture returns. Keep the monitor powered.

title: USB touchscreen accessory
instruction: Touch and swipe on a USB touchscreen.
criterion: The USB touch event count increases. This tests the attached peripheral and USB input support; it does not test the phone touchscreen.
expected: Accessory touch count increases.

title: Monitor speakers
instruction: Set monitor volume low. Run plays left, right, then both.
criterion: All three parts play clearly through the monitor.
expected: All three tones play through the monitor.

title: Monitor powered by phone
instruction: Connect the monitor with only the phone cable.
criterion: The monitor starts and shows a stable picture using phone power.
expected: Stable picture using phone power.

title: USB 3 accessory
instruction: Connect a USB 3 drive and hub; detach the monitor.
criterion: The drive appears at 5000 Mb/s or faster. Skip if you do not have this equipment.
expected: Drive reports at least 5000 Mb/s.

title: USB networking to computer
instruction: Connect to a computer with a USB data cable.
criterion: The computer detects the USB network. This does not test sustained transfer performance.
expected: A USB network interface appears on the computer.

title: USB-C charging
instruction: Connect a USB-C PD charger. Skip above 90% battery.
criterion: The displayed battery status says Charging.
expected: Battery reports Charging.

title: USB-A charging
instruction: Connect a USB-A charger. Skip above 90% battery.
criterion: The displayed battery status says Charging.
expected: Battery reports Charging.

title: Bluetooth discovery
instruction: Put an accessory in discovery / pairing mode.
criterion: Your accessory appears in the discovery output.
expected: Check its name or address below. No pairing.

title: Wi-Fi scan
instruction: Check nearby access points.
criterion: Expected SSIDs appear. No connection changes.
expected: Expected SSIDs appear. No connection changes.

title: NFC tag detection
instruction: Hold an NFC tag against the rear of the phone.
criterion: A tag target is detected; Skip if you have no tag.
expected: Tag detected. No tag contents read or written.

title: Main rear camera
instruction: Use Preview, Capture and Controls.
criterion: Live frames are stable; judge focus and supported stabilisation, exact-size capture results, and changes from advertised controls.
expected: Check the live image, exact capture sizes and control response.

instruction: Use Preview, Capture and Controls.
